wish_topics.evidence_span: I'd want people to be genuinely understood, especially in their worst moments
So much of what goes wrong seems to come from the gap between what's happening inside a person and what anyone else can see of it
If I could narrow that gap, so that being known were the default rather than a rare stroke of luck
Whole conflicts run on caricatures that neither side would recognize as themselves
a lot of the suffering that lingers is the kind no one witnessed accurately
I'd want the version where understanding comes with care attached
